notes.title: Demo Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
The feedback from our players was very helpful!
We are doing the last update on the Demo, before the full release hopefully in March/2022. 

- Tower Ranges to all towers.
- Bug fixes with UI systems.
- Options for sound regulation. (We kinda missed that previously)
- New UI for Chapter 2
- Small changes in the UI of Chapter 1

- Balancing the Mages abilities.
- Visual changes on the Materials of some of the objects in both Chapter1 and Chapter2

I hope you like the changes! Feel free to leave feedback anywhere on our social media. 
We look at all the feedback and surely will fix whats bugging you.
